steps.why: The first start unpacks the game data to /sdcard/XonoticVR. The guide has the user allow storage access.

steps.text: Open Xonotic VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for storage access, allow it. The first start unpacks the game data, which takes a few minutes. Then the game starts by itself.

notes: The APK (about 1.1 GB) holds the Xonotic 0.8.6 data, which unpacks to /sdcard/XonoticVR (about 1.8 GB). The guide says "allow storage access" without naming the permission; All files access is assumed. Releases are all pre-releases.
